# Chat & general assistants

General-purpose assistants for thinking out loud, explaining a subject, searching the web, and drafting a first pass. For model runners and local chat interfaces, use the Local AI category.

**Last verified:** October 22, 2026 · **16 tools**

[Back to the guide](../README.md) · [All categories](README.md) · [Safety checklist](../free-tier-safety.md)

> **Category tip:** Start with one assistant instead of installing ten. Give it a specific job, check important claims against a primary source, and never paste passwords, patient details, unpublished manuscripts, or other confidential material into a free account.

**Start here:** [ChatGPT](#tool-chatgpt) · [Google Gemini](#tool-google-gemini) · [Claude](#tool-claude)

## All 16 tools

<a id="tool-chatgpt"></a>

### ChatGPT

`Free tier` · Last verified: 2026-10-22

- **What is free:** Web, desktop, iOS, and Android chat on the free plan, including file and photo analysis, voice conversation, web search, and limited image creation.
- **Sign-up notes:** Email, Google, Apple, or Microsoft sign-in. No card is expected for the free web plan; phone verification may appear.
- **Limits:** Message and tool-use caps vary by model and demand. Newest reasoning or agentic features, higher usage, and some tools are paid. Model access can change.
- **Best for:** A first all-rounder for explaining a topic, brainstorming, drafting, and learning by conversation.
- **Official link:** <https://chatgpt.com>
- **Tags:** `general` `voice` `files` `beginner`

<a id="tool-microsoft-copilot"></a>

### Microsoft Copilot

`Free tier` · Last verified: 2026-10-22

- **What is free:** Free conversational AI with web grounding, image understanding, voice chat, and image generation through a Microsoft account.
- **Sign-up notes:** Free Microsoft account. No card for the basic web app; some Microsoft 365 integrations need a paid plan.
- **Limits:** Image creation relies on a limited boost allowance; premium reasoning, some Office integrations, and larger usage quotas require paid plans.
- **Best for:** Everyday research and drafting, especially if you already use Windows, Edge, or Microsoft 365.
- **Official link:** <https://copilot.microsoft.com>
- **Tags:** `general` `web-search` `images` `microsoft`

<a id="tool-google-gemini"></a>

### Google Gemini

`Free tier` · Last verified: 2026-10-22

- **What is free:** Free access to Gemini models, chat, web grounding, photo and file uploads, voice, and some image and research features with a Google account.
- **Sign-up notes:** Free Google account. No card for the web app; age, region, and feature-availability rules apply.
- **Limits:** Daily and per-feature caps apply. Deep Research, video/image generation, the most capable models, and very large uploads have stricter limits or paid access.
- **Best for:** A mainstream assistant with strong Google-ecosystem integration and multimodal questions.
- **Official link:** <https://gemini.google.com>
- **Tags:** `general` `research` `files` `google`

<a id="tool-claude"></a>

### Claude

`Free tier` · Last verified: 2026-10-22

- **What is free:** Web, desktop, and mobile chat with file uploads, long-document reading, writing help, and limited AI-powered artifacts/tools.
- **Sign-up notes:** Email or Google sign-in. No card for the free plan; phone verification may be requested.
- **Limits:** A daily usage allowance resets periodically. Hit the cap and you must wait or upgrade. Some advanced models, longer usage, and higher file/tool limits are paid.
- **Best for:** Careful writing, document questions, editing, and thoughtful explanations in a calm interface.
- **Official link:** <https://claude.ai>
- **Tags:** `writing` `documents` `analysis` `general`

`Free tier` · Last verified: 2026-10-22

- **What is free:** AI answers with cited web sources, follow-up questions, file analysis, and a limited number of advanced research searches.

`Free tier` · Last verified: 2026-10-22

### Poe

`Free tier` · Last verified: 2026-10-22

- **What is free:** One account for many chat models and community-built bots, with a daily allocation of compute points.

### DuckDuckGo AI Chat

`Free tier` · Last verified: 2026-10-22

### Google AI Studio

`Free tier` · Last verified: 2026-10-22
